_doc: Sector adaptation registry for the capital-allocation-strategy skill. Match order: (1) company industry (broad bucket from the master/search_tickerid) against match_industries; (2) fall back to classification (granular) against match_classifications; (3) else _default. Each profile tunes priority_levers (section emphasis), scorecard_weights (weighted Overall score), leverage_metric + roic_framework (valid balance-sheet/return lenses), suppress (analyses not meaningful for the sector), and classification_hint. Vocabulary verified against a 620-company master (not bundled) on 2026-07-22. This file only sets emphasis, labels, and weights; it never fabricates data.

_default.label: Generic
_default.narrative_lens: Assess whether cash generated is returned, reinvested, or retained, and whether the mix earns a return above the cost of capital.

Software.label: Software & Technology
Software.narrative_lens: Software/TMT: cash is largely discretionary. The debate is buybacks vs AI/data-center capex vs M&A. Watch FCF conversion (FCF / Net Income), SBC-adjusted buyback (are repurchases merely offsetting dilution?), and whether escalating AI capex earns an incremental return above cost of capital.

Banks.label: Banks & Financials
Banks.narrative_lens: Banks: capital return is governed by regulatory capital (CET1) and stress-test capacity, not FCF. Judge total payout ratio (buyback + dividend / net income), CET1 headroom vs requirement, tangible book value per share growth, and ROTCE vs cost of equity. Capex is immaterial; do not score it.
Banks._classification_note: Institutional Financial Services is EXCLUDED, not matched. It is the feed's label for advisory and capital-markets firms, which have no loan book, no CET1 and no risk-weighted assets - an advisory firm was templated as a bank and resolved CET1 as its leverage metric while returning no results for CET1, RWA or total debt. Asset Management was excluded after the same failure with a large asset manager. The routing precondition in sector_router.py is the backstop for the general case; this list handles the two labels known to mis-sweep.

Industrials.label: Industrials & Materials
Industrials.narrative_lens: Industrials: reinvestment economics dominate. Judge maintenance vs growth capex, whether capex is expanding capacity/backlog, acquisition multiples and integration, and whether ROIC exceeds WACC through the cycle. Balance returns against cyclical balance-sheet resilience.

Energy.label: Energy & Utilities
match_classifications: Oil and Gas Services and Equipment
Energy.narrative_lens: Energy: the framework is the FCF waterfall and the shareholder-return framework (base + variable dividend, buyback). Judge breakeven discipline, reinvestment rate (capex/CFO), production/reserve growth, and whether returns are sustainable across the commodity cycle rather than only at peak prices. Utilities: rate-base growth capex is the value driver, funded by a mix of retained earnings, debt, and equity.

Healthcare.label: Health Care
Healthcare.narrative_lens: Healthcare/Pharma: pipeline reinvestment (R&D + business development) competes with buybacks and dividends. Judge whether M&A is replacing patent-cliff revenue at a defensible multiple, R&D productivity, and whether returns fund innovation without impairing the balance sheet.

Consumer.label: Consumer & Retail
Consumer.narrative_lens: Consumer/Retail: unit economics drive the reinvestment case. Judge new-unit/store returns and capex productivity (sales per square foot, ROIIC), whether expansion is self-funding, and how much residual FCF is returned. Watch lease-adjusted leverage.

Insurance.label: Insurance
Insurance.narrative_lens: Insurance: judge total capital return against statutory capital adequacy, book-value-per-share growth, combined ratio discipline, and ROE vs cost of equity. Capex is immaterial.

REIT.label: Real Estate (REIT)
REIT.narrative_lens: REITs: the dividend is quasi-mandatory (90% taxable-income distribution), so judge AFFO payout ratio and coverage, development/acquisition yields vs cost of capital, and whether growth is funded with accretive equity (issue above NAV) or dilutive equity. Watch leverage and the debt maturity ladder.
REIT._classification_note: v2.73.0. Real Estate Services and Real Estate Owners and Developers report no FFO or AFFO. Under this profile they got the REIT module, whose AFFO rows the router's REAL_ESTATE_SERVICES / REAL_ESTATE_OPERATING templates forbid, so gate G8 blocked every such report. Excluded here, they take the default lens the router templates expect.

Telecom.label: Telecommunications
Telecom.narrative_lens: Telecom: capital allocation is dominated by network and spectrum capex against a leveraged balance sheet and a large, closely-watched dividend. Judge capex intensity and its trend, free cash flow after capex and dividends, leverage against the stated target, and whether spectrum or fibre spending is earning a return above cost of capital.

_dead_key_note: classification_hint was removed in v2.68.0: it was declared on the sector profiles and read by no script. A config key nothing consumes reads as a tuning surface and is not one.
